answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 129 Country: India Title: I need some tafseer books, can you suggest which one to take? Question: I need some tafseer books. Can you suggest which one to take. I also want some books written by qasim nanotvi saheb and also by ashraf ali thanvi saheb. Can you tell some of the good books which they has written. Please reply me soon. Answer ID: 129 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 232/B=273/B) Maariful Quran is the best and comprehensive Urdu tafseer, while Tafseer-e-Usmani is the best short Urdu tafseer; it is known as Tarjama Shaikhul Hind also. The books of Hazrat Nanotavi have been published in one volume. You may buy the set. His books are academic and philosophical. It is difficult for a non-Aalim to understand them. Hazrat Thanvi has written so many books, amongst which Bahishti Zewar, Hayatul Muslimin, Bawadirun Nawadir, Shariat-w-Tariqat, Al-Ifazatul Yaumiah and Dawat-e-Abdiyat may be useful for you to study. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
